systems.system: Décret on security audit, control and certification of information systems used in electronic transactions (read on national television 21 May 2026)
systems.tiers: all public and private enterprises and establishments in electronic transactions, and foreign firms serving Guinean residents

note: The decree reported is a cybersecurity audit and certification regime run by ARPT; the article does not say it is made under an electronic transactions or e-commerce law, so it is class other and gives no fact.
